description: Read-only WebAZ product search and inspection; no auth. Exact-first: use a full title, SKU or precise alias, filters, @anchor, or supported external shopping reference. No match stays empty; do not retry with looser terms or auto-page. Unconstrained browse is capped. result_handle/selected_ids/full_terms and cursor are only for explicit follow-ups. Returns a complete structured product result; never orders or reserves stock.

anchor.description: WebAZ @anchor for its exact tagged product

full_terms.description: Explicit follow-up: complete public terms for selected products

limit.description: Page size; default 5. Unconstrained browse is capped at 8.

max_handling_hours.description: Max handling hours (optional, e.g. 24 = only ≤24h dispatch)

min_return_days.description: Min return days (optional, e.g. 7 = only ≥7-day return)

paste_text.description: Raw external share text or link

recommend_id.description: Legacy display-only highlight; never triggers another search

selected_ids.description: With result_handle: 1..5 product ids chosen FROM that result page.

sort.description: Sort: trending=composite (default) / newest / rating / price_asc / price_desc / random

name: webaz_search

outputSchema.description: webaz.product_search.model.v1 (search/browse) OR webaz.product_detail.model.v1 (detail-fetch via result_handle) — model projection: decision fields plus an optional reviewed cover thumbnail URL (no raw DB rows or internal scores)

decision_facts.description: deterministic objective comparisons only (price/sales/handling/return); never a subjective recommendation

detail_required_for_card.description: deprecated v1.0 compatibility field; false because ordinary results are already display-ready

error.description: present ONLY on failure (with error_code + structured recovery fields)

fx.description: display-only USD-base rates ({rates,as_of}) for ≈local hints; never a settlement path

next_cursor.description: capability for a user-requested next page; never follow automatically

cover_image_url.description: optional WebAZ-hosted reviewed product cover thumbnail

price.description: product price: amount_minor / currency USDC / display (display line only; fx table gives display-only local conversions)

response_type.description: authoritative compact result state; consumers must not infer a different state from counts

result_handle.description: 10-minute capability for an explicit user-selected follow-up; never continue automatically

selection_required.description: deprecated v1.0 compatibility field; false because v1.1 does not require an automatic selection/follow-up

sellers.description: deduped seller summaries keyed by seller id (products[].seller_ref)
